Looping you in — Anna is asking for a cohort grant plus deferred invoicing. Quick thoughts below, happy to hand to Ben to draft external options.

Key constraints: Redwood's hosted promo credits are typically granted up front and are non-refundable; billing terms (Net30/Net60) need finance approval for promotional deals >$25k. For cohorts that require a usage buffer across teams we usually: 

- Offer a staged grant: 50% upfront credit, 50% reserve that unlocks after month 6 usage review (reduces risk of unused credits).
- Provide per-team top-ups at a discounted rate (e.g., 20% off list) with a minimum top-up size per team.
- For Net60 requests we can offer deferred invoicing with a small surcharge or require an ACH mandate + PO; otherwise offer Net30 + promo credit to achieve effective Net60 economics.

I'm attaching our draft accelerator terms (redwood-accelerator-terms.pdf) and a quick pricing scenarios CSV. Ben — can you convert into 2-3 client-facing options (one conservative, one aggressive) and include a short MAP (M-A-P: milestones, acceptance criteria, payment triggers)?

Thanks,
Irene
Head of Strategic GTM
Redwood Inference

Hi Anna — thanks for the clear ask and for the MAP. I've sketched three practical options below; attaching the CSV with per-team math. Happy to walk through any of these on a call.

Option A — Minimal risk (fast turnaround)
- 100k credits grant up front to the program (covers mentor sessions + demos).
- Per-team top-up available at 25% off list; invoiced Net30.
- Redwood requires PO and ACH set up for deferred invoicing requests.

Option B — Cohort buffer (balanced)
- 150k credits total: 75% upfront, 25% reserve unlocked at week 6 after usage review.
- Per-team top-ups at 20% off list; reserved credits can be reallocated between teams.
- Invoicing: Net30 with an option to defer final invoice (up to Net60) subject to CFO sign-off + ACH mandate.

Option C — Growth-friendly (sales concession)
- 200k credits upfront + 6-week runway top-up tranche.
- Per-team top-ups at 30% off list for the first 3 months.
- Redwood agrees to invoice 50% now, 50% Net60 post-demo day (requires Deal Approval: discount cap 35% and finance escalation).

I'll open a HubSpot deal record for Orchid and log these options: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/98765.

Next steps:
- If you prefer one of the above, we'll prepare a short SOW + DocuSign (typical turnaround 48 hours once terms agreed).
- If Mike wants Net60 without ACH, we'll need finance approval (likely a small revenue holdback or surcharge).

Would you be available Mon 7/19 10:00 AM PT for a quick call?

Cheers,
